title: Department of State AIRGRAM: Unidentified Flying Objects Reported Over Angola, December 23, 1966
doc_notes: This document is a Department of State Airgram reporting on a press account of a UAP sighting near Luanda, Angola, in December 1966.

incidents.summary: Passengers and crew of a TAP flight from Beira to Luanda reported sighting two unidentified objects scouting their aircraft.
incidents.quote: two lights at the side of my aircraft
